credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Black Marble 2016 / Suomi NPP VIIRS
license: NASA imagery use guidelines; educational/informational use with acknowledgment, no endorsement.
acquisition_epoch: 2016 annual composite, not a single-date observation
transform: Unmodified publisher grayscale JPEG. Runtime extracts one channel at native resolution. A display-only power curve (exponent 0.65) lifts faint light detail before sRGB decoding; the shader applies a warm tint and the existing 0.35 emission gain. Black and peak mask values are unchanged.
limits: Static display artwork, not current city activity, calibrated radiance, historical weather or RF/thermal input.
Loaded on GPUs supporting a texture width of at least 13500 pixels; preserved 8K/2K artwork remains the fallback.

Single-channel storage is about 115.87 MiB including mipmaps, plus 86.9 MiB retained CPU data. Bitmap decode temporarily requires about 348 MiB; conversion uses 128-row strips and releases the bitmap.
